name: Koyfin
description: A cross-asset charting and dashboard platform for advisors and investors: stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, government yields, indices, currencies, commodities, global macro data, earnings transcripts and crypto in one workspace, with customizable dashboards, watchlists and an equity screener. Useful here as a design reference for macro dashboard layout and multi-asset chart presentation, not as a data feed.

notes: Free registration required (work or personal email, or Google/Apple sign-in); no credit card. New sign-ups get a 7-day trial of paid features that then downgrades automatically to the free plan.

Free plan (as marketed on the pricing page): advanced charting, market and macro dashboards, 'My Portfolios' tracking, 2 years of financial data plus 1 year of estimates, 2 watchlists, 2 screens, 2 custom dashboards, limited company snapshots and restricted news access. No ETF holdings data, stock/ETF screeners or premium research (press releases, SEC filings) on the free tier.
The marketing site (koyfin.com) is reachable without login; the working app (app.koyfin.com) requires a signed-in session.

terms.summary: A Terms and Conditions page exists (app.koyfin.com/terms-and-conditions) but the page renders client-side and could not be fetched as text; a paraphrase found via search describes a no-redistribution/no-reproduction clause covering the site's own content and third-party (e.g. Morningstar) data, but that paraphrase is not a verbatim quote and is not used as a citation here.
